subject: tr
title: TR.------A.PR.
description: Chart on book p. 468 (TRF(II)-4). TR (transformation) is the subject; A-PR (all-purpose) is the partner. From the subject: WO-UNF (world unification), INFO-DY and VT-PLT (vibrational platform). From WO-UNF: DEC (decentralization) and POL-DY (political dynamics). From POL-DY: POL-P (political policies). From POL-P: C-PROG. From INFO-DY: MT-INFO (multi-information). From MT-INFO: C-RH (composite research). From C-RH: EXB-H-OR (establishing high order). From VT-PLT: POST (postulation). From POST: SPT-UNF (spiritual unification). From SPT-UNF: AFI (affinity insight). From A-PR: EXT-FT (extended functionalism), whose label has no dot of its own and stands beside the A-PR dot.
